tasks.label: railway-find-tradeaid-projects
tasks.command: $projects = railway list --json | ConvertFrom-Json; $projects | Where-Object { $_.name -match 'trade aid' } | ForEach-Object { "PROJECT: $($_.name) | ID: $($_.id)"; $_.services.edges | ForEach-Object { "  SERVICE: $($_.node.name) | ID: $($_.node.id)" } }

tasks.label: railway-find-tradeaid-projects-2
tasks.command: $projects = railway list --json | ConvertFrom-Json; $projects | Where-Object { $_.name -match 'trade aid' } | ForEach-Object { Write-Output ('PROJECT ' + $_.name + ' ID ' + $_.id); $_.services.edges | ForEach-Object { Write-Output ('SERVICE ' + $_.node.name + ' ID ' + $_.node.id) } }
